title: Extend Python social blog API with user updates, post likes, and author filtering
description: Multi-step Python task: extend a working FastAPI social blog app with user management improvements, a like system for posts, and author-based post filtering.

task_spec.prompt:
The existing blog API has users, posts, and comments. Add three groups of features to src/app.py.

Step 1 — User management improvements:
  PUT /users/{user_id}  — update username and/or email (partial update OK); 404 if not found
  DELETE /users/{user_id} — delete user; 404 if not found; 204 on success

Step 2 — Like system for posts:
  POST /posts/{post_id}/like   — add a like to the post; 404 if post not found; 200 {"likes": N}
  DELETE /posts/{post_id}/like — remove a like (floor at 0); 404 if not found; 200 {"likes": N}
  GET /posts/{post_id}/likes   — return {"likes": N}; 404 if not found
  Store likes as a dict _post_likes: dict[int, int] = {} in module scope.
  Add likes reset to the existing reset() function.

Step 3 — Author filtering on post list:
  GET /posts?author_id=X — return only posts where post["author_id"] == X (integer)
  If ?author_id is absent, return all posts as before.

All 7 existing tests plus new solution tests must pass.
Run: uv run pytest tests/ -v
success_criteria: uv run ruff check src/ passes
followup_prompts: Good progress. Run `uv run pytest tests/ -v` to see where we stand. Continue with the remaining steps, prioritizing the parts the tests depend on most.
Final push: run `uv run pytest tests/ -v` and fix any remaining failures. Make sure the full implementation is complete and all tests pass.
